from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import date
class PageParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.ids=[]
        self.names=[]
    def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
        a=dict(attrs)
        if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
        if tag in ('input','textarea'): self.names.append(a.get('name'))
p=PageParser()
s=Path('index.html').read_text()
p.feed(s)
assert len(p.ids)==len(set(p.ids)), 'Duplicate IDs'
assert set(['name','attendance','guests','dietary']) <= set(p.names)
assert '<title>' in s and 'width=device-width' in s
print('HTML parsed successfully; form fields and unique IDs verified.')
print('June 14, 2027:', date(2027,6,14).strftime('%A'))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import date
import subprocess
class PageParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.ids=[]
        self.names=[]
    def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
        a=dict(attrs)
        if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
        if tag in ('input','textarea'): self.names.append(a.get('name'))
s=Path('index.html').read_text()
p=PageParser()
p.feed(s)
assert len(p.ids)==len(set(p.ids)), 'Duplicate IDs'
assert {'name','attendance','guests','dietary'} <= set(p.names)
assert '<title>' in s and 'width=device-width' in s
script=s.split('<script>')[1].split('</script>')[0]

assert result.returncode==0, result.stderr
print('Passed: HTML parsing, unique IDs, required form fields, mobile viewport, and JavaScript syntax.')
print('Date check:', date(2027,6,14).strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y'))
PY"
